items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: he said - you got a steady job here

ctx.x: And, once I thought I had it made; I went to the 400 Club, I had a hell of a band -- and every-thing and he said - you got a steady job here; I'll give you so much a week - $450 a week - just for you and every-thing was fine - go along fine; it lasted the most six weeks.
